in_marathi.name: Laxman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laxman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Laxman is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'laxmanas' which means 'supporting one'. In Hindu mythology, Laxman is the younger brother of Lord Rama and the brother-in-law of Sita. He is known for his unwavering devotion and commitment to his brother and his wife. Laxman is often depicted holding a bow and arrow, symbolizing his courage and strength.
